done_when: no test creates, names or archives a thread in the user's real Codex home: every test that reaches Codex uses a throwaway Codex home, and a test run leaves the real home's thread list unchanged, proven by an end-to-end test

findings.body: The real home is read only after the run, and this assertion checks only that the isolated `forge ask` thread IDs are absent there. It cannot detect other new threads or changes to existing thread names or archive status. The before/after comparison at line 61 covers only the newly created `configured_home`. Add a before/after comparison of the real home's complete thread list around the conversation-producing test run so the explicitly required invariant is actually verified.
findings.title: Not done: a test run leaves the real home's thread list unchanged, proven by an end-to-end test

why: Forge's test suite starts real Codex conversations in the user's own Codex home, so every test run leaves new threads in their Codex chat list
